## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A run producing three edits yields a branch with exactly three commits, each...

The system SHALL ensure that a run producing three edits yields a branch with exactly three commits, each body containing action kind, instruction ids, and quotes from at least two distinct qualifying sessions, plus a proposal.json listing three edit keys.

#### Scenario: A run producing three edits yields a branch with exactly three commits, each...

WHEN `deliver-memory-edits-as-commits-with-proposal-json` is implemented
THEN A run producing three edits yields a branch with exactly three commits, each body containing action kind, instruction ids, and quotes from at least two distinct qualifying sessions, plus a proposal.json listing three edit keys.

### Requirement: An add edit that pushes the always-loaded surface over budget is rejected in...

The system SHALL ensure that an add edit that pushes the always-loaded surface over budget is rejected in code and the run fails after at most two re-prompts with the rejected proposal preserved on disk.

#### Scenario: An add edit that pushes the always-loaded surface over budget is rejected in...

WHEN `deliver-memory-edits-as-commits-with-proposal-json` is implemented
THEN An add edit that pushes the always-loaded surface over budget is rejected in code and the run fails after at most two re-prompts with the rejected proposal preserved on disk.

### Requirement: A remove edit backed only by non-compliance evidence is rejected; an extract...

The system SHALL ensure that a remove edit backed only by non-compliance evidence is rejected; an extract edit whose removed lines do not all reappear in the target SKILL.md is rejected (asserted by tests).

#### Scenario: A remove edit backed only by non-compliance evidence is rejected; an extract...

WHEN `deliver-memory-edits-as-commits-with-proposal-json` is implemented
THEN A remove edit backed only by non-compliance evidence is rejected; an extract edit whose removed lines do not all reappear in the target SKILL.md is rejected (asserted by tests).

### Requirement: Reverting one commit and rerunning records that edit key in the rejection...

The system SHALL ensure that reverting one commit and rerunning records that edit key in the rejection ledger and does not re-propose it.

#### Scenario: Reverting one commit and rerunning records that edit key in the rejection...

WHEN `deliver-memory-edits-as-commits-with-proposal-json` is implemented
THEN Reverting one commit and rerunning records that edit key in the rejection ledger and does not re-propose it.
